title: MASIM: Multilingual Agent-Based Simulation for Social Science

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the attitude distributions of LLM-simulated multicultural agents to real-world global survey data (GlobalOpinionQA, World Values Survey) using Root Mean Square Error (RMSE) to evaluate cultural alignment and representativeness.
Measuring the discrepancy in real-world calibration when multi-agent simulations are conducted in a country's native language versus English to test for English-centric value representation.
